island_messages.raw: §fI've been living on this island for 10 years.
island_messages.text: I've been living on this island for 10 years.
island_messages.zh: 我在这座岛上住了 10 年了。

island_messages.raw: §fBefore that, I used to compete in sugar cane contests.
island_messages.text: Before that, I used to compete in sugar cane contests.
island_messages.zh: 再早些时候,我还经常参加甘蔗比赛呢。

island_messages.raw: §fI've now retired to this house to live out the rest of my days.
island_messages.text: I've now retired to this house to live out the rest of my days.
island_messages.zh: 现在退休了,就守着这间小屋,安安稳稳过日子。

messages.raw: §fI've competed in numerous sugar cane contests, but I've never actually tried farming other crops.
messages.text: I've competed in numerous sugar cane contests, but I've never actually tried farming other crops.
messages.zh: 甘蔗比赛我参加过不少,可还真没种过别的作物。

messages.raw: §fThis'll be a nice hobby to work on. Thank you.
messages.text: This'll be a nice hobby to work on. Thank you.
messages.zh: 往后正好多个爱好。谢啦。

messages.text: Cultivating sugar cane gets boring eventually.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。

note:
身份: 退休甘蔗竞赛选手,花园访客。
关系: 来向玩家收购作物。
说话方式: 平实闲聊。
性格与词汇: 有经验却愿意尝试新作物。
禁用风格: 不把爱好写成正式任务。
source_note: 拒绝台词于 2026-09-12 以新版社区 Wiki Dialogue 表补齐，并由 Fandom 历史档案交叉核对；现有其他台词保留游戏内实测状态。
